source.title: String Quartet in F major — II. Assez vif — Très rythmé
source.edition: OpenScore String Quartets; transcribed from IMSLP #335585

bars.description: Movement II only: bars 1–198 once in written order. No repeat signs occur in the selected MusicXML; thematic returns are written out.

endpoints.basis: Initial score-pitch windows from existing recording analysis; refine using pitch-energy inspection before publication.

provenance: Select zero-based half-open MusicXML measure indices [213, 411] from every part, preserving inherited clefs, keys and time signatures. Original CC0 MXL download remains unchanged.
Four source-defined instrument parts are retained, including all explicitly encoded subsidiary voices within each staff. MIDI articulations are not used to invent performed note lengths.
Metric-equivalence instructions and textual dynamics require semantics-preserving conversion to text for LilyPond 2.24.4; no note or rhythmic content is removed.
